Overview

Miskolc is a city in Borsod-Abaúj-Zemplén with a population of 154,521. Hungary’s fourth-largest city, a former industrial center transformed with thermal baths, the stunning Lillafüred Palace Hotel, and the Bükk Mountains nearby. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
